programme.title: Der Bunker
programme.desc: A young student seeks quiet and solitude to focus on an important work but ends up as the teacher of a peculiar boy who is home-schooled by his parents in an isolated bunker mansion.

programme.title: Dot Com Mom
programme.desc: In this fish out of water tale, a traditional Indian house wife, visits her successful son in the USA but this simple mother cannot cope with the modern ways and soon finds herself in trouble.

programme.title: Divorce Invitation
programme.desc: Mike Christian, a happily married man runs into his high school sweetheart Alex, and after all these years, sparks still fly. When Mike is determined Alex is his true soul mate, he realizes he has a huge problem-he signed an iron-clad pre-nuptial agreement and his wife will not let him out of the marriage. Starring Jamie-Lynn Sigler, Jonathan Bennett, Elliott Gould

programme.title: Death Of A Soldier
programme.desc: Based on a true story, James Coburn portrays a military lawyer assigned to defend a confessed psychotic killer. Set in WWII and the uneasy US-Australian military alliance. programme.title: Corrado
